sources_considered.why: Documents research focused on prediction performance and compute allocation, but does not establish displacement of theory.
Shows that meaning-model research existed alongside prediction research, but coexistence cannot settle whether more theory work would otherwise have occurred.

evidence_items.explanation: This documents a research program centered on prediction performance. It contains no comparison showing that this program diverted resources or attention from theories of cognitive world models.

unresolved_gaps: No located source documents the alleged displacement through identifiable funding, staffing or project decisions.
No located study estimates how much relevant theory work would have occurred without the priority given to prediction.
Neither the presence nor the absence of particular theory papers settles the causal claim.
